thought.text: The toolchain passes and the app logs show expected behavior. However, I noticed a `Failed to resolve entry for package "@sva/plugin-generic-items"` error in the log. Let me check whether that's a current problem or a historical event, and get the actual HTML content.

reasoning_content:
The toolchain consistency check passed and the app is running with expected logs showing the Keycloak circuit breaker opened as anticipated and a legitimate authorization rejection for the instances endpoint since the mock user lacks the required admin role.

I'm noticing a `Failed to resolve entry for package "@sva/plugin-generic-items"` error in the logs — I need to determine if this is an ongoing critical issue or a historical transient that self-recovered, since the installer reported the build completed successfully and the app started and served requests without problems. Let me check when these errors occurred relative to the app startup time and whether they're still being triggered by live requests.

The UI title check came back empty, so I need to fetch the full HTML response to see what's actually being served.

action.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== count of plugin resolution errors over full log ==="; grep -c 'plugin-generic-items' /tmp/app-serve2.log; echo "=== first & last occurrence (with timestamps) ==="; grep -n 'Failed to resolve entry' /tmp/app-serve2.log | head -3; grep -n 'Failed to resolve entry' /tmp/app-serve2.log | tail -3
echo; echo "=== log start line ==="; head -3 /tmp/app-serve2.log
echo; echo "=== any errors AFTER 15:06 (post-startup) ? ==="; awk '/2026-10-15T15:0[6-9]|2026-10-15T15:1[0-9]/' /tmp/app-serve2.log 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'error|fatal' | grep -viE 'keycloak|role guard|circuit' | head -10 || echo none
